title: ACE-Step reintegration after FA3 router hardware GUI and coexistence changes

notes: No fixed NVIDIA RTX SKU or CUDA baseline is introduced.
FA3 remains CPU-only capable globally; ACE-Step accelerator execution is workload-scoped and HRB admitted.
Physical current-host promotion is not claimed by this decision.

integration.model_router: All ACE-Step model/provider selection is subordinate to FA3-AUTH-MODEL-ROUTER-001; no private parallel router or silent fallback.
integration.hrb: Accelerator placement reservation and lease remain exclusively FA3-AUTH-HOST-RESOURCE-BROKER-001.
integration.gui: Expose ACE-Step inside AI Studio Music workspace as a provider projection, not as a new application authority.
integration.coexistence: FA3 ACE-Step runtime must use namespaced isolated state/config/cache/service/socket/port/runtime surfaces and must coexist with upstream or independently installed ACE-Step.
integration.native_artifacts: Generated lossless WAV/FLAC masters and project provenance remain first-class artifacts; DAW handoff must not destroy native project files.
integration.creative_studio: Music generation is consumable by Creative Studio/Video Editor/QuickClip through provider-neutral media artifacts; no direct provider authority leaks into editor core.

open_risks: PR #1301 duration-aware VRAM work remains reference-only until merged/admitted
PR #1311 LM reinit memory leak fix remains open
PR #1321 quantization probe logger fix remains open
Issue #1329 XL-SFT cover renoise near-silence remains an affected-flow promotion blocker
